Unless... the pushing isn't order-based but "the smaller/later object passes"? Or maybe objects are ordered by size? 3-plus (5 cells) vs 1-cross (7 cells): smaller at bottom? 8 (6 cells) vs 2-bottom (5): smaller 2-bottom at bottom → B. 2-top (8 cells) vs 8 (6): 8 smaller → 8 at bottom?? Under size rule bottom: smallest lands bottom: 2-bottom(5) rows13-15; 8(6) rests on it rows9-12; 2-top(8) cols10-14 no conflict rows12-15. Same as B! Ugh.

T1 (my original): 3 rows0-2, 1-left rows3-5, 1-right rows0-4.

T3 nearest-first: same as T1.

Hmm, actually wait. Maybe I should reconsider the whole rule. Maybe it's not per-object edge gravity. def transform4(grid):
    g=np.array(grid); H,W=g.shape
    cs=comps_of(grid)
    info=[]
    for c in cs:
        hh=hole_cells(grid,c['cells'])
        ys=[p[0] for p in c['cells']]; xs=[p[1] for p in c['cells']]
        top=min(ys)
        info.append({'col':c['col'],'cells':c['cells'],'hole':len(hh)>0,
                     'top':top,'bot':max(ys),'cols':set(xs),'left':min(xs),
                     'toprow':{x for (y,x) in c['cells'] if y==top}})
    canvas=np.zeros_like(g)
    hollows=sorted([o for o in info if o['hole']], key=lambda o:(o['top'],o['left']))
    placed_top={}
    for o in hollows:
        h=max(p[0] for p in o['cells'])-min(p[0] for p in o['cells'])+1
        r=0
        while True:
            conflict=False
            for q in placed_top.values():
                if o['cols'] & q['cols'] and r < q['r']+q['h'] and r+h > q['r']:
                    conflict=True; r=q['r']+q['h']; break
            if not conflict: break
        placed_top[id(o)]={'r':r,'h':h,'cols':o['cols']}
        for y,x in o['cells']: canvas[r+(y-o['top']), x]=o['col']
    solids=sorted([o for o in info if not o['hole']], key=lambda o:(-(o['bot']),o['left']))
    placed_bot=[]
    for o in solids:
        h=o['bot']-o['top']+1
        r=H-h
        while True:
            conflict=False
            for q in placed_bot:
                if o['cols'] & q['cols'] and r < q['r']+q['h'] and r+h > q['r']:
                    conflict=True; r=q['r']-h; break
            if not conflict: break
        fall = (H-h) - o['top']
        deform = fall%2==1 and any((o['cols'] <= ho['toprow']) and (o['top'] < ho['bot']) for ho in hollows)
        placed_bot.append({'r':r,'h':h,'cols':o['cols']})
        cells=[(r+(y-o['top']),x) for y,x in o['cells']]
        rep=sym_dist1(cells)
        if rep is not None: cells=rep
        elif deform:
            topy=min(c[0] for c in cells)
            for t in [c for c in cells if c[0]==topy]:
                cells=[c for c in cells if c!=t]+[(t[0],t[1]+1)]
        for y,x in cells: canvas[y,x]=o['col']
    return [list(r) for r in canvas]

def transform5(grid):
    g=np.array(grid); H,W=g.shape
    cs=comps_of(grid)
    info=[]
    for c in cs:
        hh=hole_cells(grid,c['cells'])
        ys=[p[0] for p in c['cells']]; xs=[p[1] for p in c['cells']]
        top=min(ys)
        info.append({'col':c['col'],'cells':c['cells'],'hole':len(hh)>0,
                     'top':top,'bot':max(ys),'cols':set(xs),'left':min(xs),
                     'toprow':{x for (y,x) in c['cells'] if y==top}})
    canvas=np.zeros_like(g)
    hollows=sorted([o for o in info if o['hole']], key=lambda o:(o['top'],o['left']))
    placed_top={}
    for o in hollows:
        h=max(p[0] for p in o['cells'])-min(p[0] for p in o['cells'])+1
        r=0
        while True:
            conflict=False
            for q in placed_top.values():
                if o['cols'] & q['cols'] and r < q['r']+q['h'] and r+h > q['r']:
                    conflict=True; r=q['r']+q['h']; break
            if not conflict: break
        placed_top[id(o)]={'r':r,'h':h,'cols':o['cols']}
        for y,x in o['cells']: canvas[r+(y-o['top']), x]=o['col']
    solids=sorted([o for o in info if not o['hole']], key=lambda o:(-(o['bot']),o['left']))
    placed_bot=[]
    for o in solids:
        h=o['bot']-o['top']+1
        r=H-h
        while True:
            conflict=False
            for q in placed_bot:
                if o['cols'] & q['cols'] and r < q['r']+q['h'] and r+h > q['r']:
                    conflict=True; r=q['r']-h; break
            if not conflict: break
        # crossing with a rising hollow that fully spans the solid's columns
        crossed = any((o['cols'] <= ho['toprow']) and (o['top'] < ho['bot']) for ho in hollows)
        placed_bot.append({'r':r,'h':h,'cols':o['cols']})
        cells=[(r+(y-o['top']),x) for y,x in o['cells']]
        rep=sym_dist1(cells)
        if rep is not None: cells=rep
        elif crossed:

                     'top':top,'bot':max(ys),'cols':set(xs),'left':min(xs),
                     'toprow':{x for (y,x) in c['cells'] if y==top}})
    canvas=np.zeros_like(g)
    hollows=sorted([o for o in info if o['hole']], key=lambda o:(o['top'],o['left']))
    placed_top={}
    for o in hollows:
        h=max(p[0] for p in o['cells'])-min(p[0] for p in o['cells'])+1
        r=0
        while True:
            conflict=False
            for q in placed_top.values():
                if o['cols'] & q['cols'] and r < q['r']+q['h'] and r+h > q['r']:
                    conflict=True; r=q['r']+q['h']; break
            if not conflict: break
        placed_top[id(o)]={'r':r,'h':h,'cols':o['cols']}
        for y,x in o['cells']: canvas[r+(y-o['top']), x]=o['col']

def transform7(grid):
    g=np.array(grid); H,W=g.shape
    cs=comps_of(grid)
    info=[]
    for c in cs:
        hh=hole_cells(grid,c['cells'])
        ys=[p[0] for p in c['cells']]; xs=[p[1] for p in c['cells']]
        top=min(ys)
        info.append({'col':c['col'],'cells':c['cells'],'hole':len(hh)>0,
                     'top':top,'bot':max(ys),'cols':set(xs),'left':min(xs),
                     'toprow':{x for (y,x) in c['cells'] if y==top}})
    canvas=np.zeros_like(g)
    hollows=sorted([o for o in info if o['hole']], key=lambda o:(-o['left'],o['top']))
    placed_top={}
    for o in hollows:
        h=max(p[0] for p in o['cells'])-min(p[0] for p in o['cells'])+1
        r=0
        while True:
            conflict=False
            for q in placed_top.values():
                if o['cols'] & q['cols'] and r < q['r']+q['h'] and r+h > q['r']:
                    conflict=True; r=q['r']+q['h']; break
            if not conflict: break
        placed_top[id(o)]={'r':r,'h':h,'cols':o['cols']}
        for y,x in o['cells']: canvas[r+(y-o['top']), x]=o['col']
    solids=sorted([o for o in info if not o['hole']], key=lambda o:(-(o['bot']),o['left']))
    placed_bot=[]
    for o in solids:
        h=o['bot']-o['top']+1
        r=H-h
        while True:
            conflict=False
            for q in placed_bot:
                if o['cols'] & q['cols'] and r < q['r']+q['h'] and r+h > q['r']:
                    conflict=True; r=q['r']-h; break
            if not conflict: break
        fall=(H-h)-o['top']
        deform=False
        for ho in hollows:
            rise=ho['top']
            if (o['cols'] <= ho['toprow']) and (o['top'] < ho['bot']) and fall > rise:
                deform=True
        placed_bot.append({'r':r,'h':h,'cols':o['cols']})
        cells=[(r+(y-o['top']),x) for y,x in o['cells']]
        rep=sym_dist1(cells)
        if rep is not None: cells=rep
        elif deform:
            topy=min(c[0] for c in cells)
            armx=max(x for (y,x) in cells if y==topy+1) if any(y==topy+1 for y,x in cells) else max(x for y,x in cells)
            for t in [c for c in cells if c[0]==topy]:
                cells=[c for c in cells if c!=t]+[(t[0],armx)]
        for y,x in cells: canvas[y,x]=o['col']
    return [list(r) for r in canvas]
